# Flash-UI portfolio import

Copy the complete `dist/portfolio/sites/commission-calculator/` folder into the portfolio repository's `sites/` directory. Do not flatten the variant folders or remove `shared/`. The export uses local relative paths and can run at arbitrary nested URLs. The gallery is the grouped project's entry point; each variant is a separate working application. Variant 1 is marked as selected.

The adjacent `proposed-registry-entry.json` follows the core static-site fields of the supplied portfolio snapshot, with proposed grouped metadata. The snapshot predates the latest group implementation; inspect the current loader and grouping schema before applying the entry. Add using the existing additive registry mechanism; do not replace `data/site-registry.json` or other assets. No external repository changes are included. Run the existing live-path smoke test after an authorized import/deploy, including the gallery and all four variants. The portfolio export strips all partner destinations and accepts only demonstration compensation config. Before publishing, inspect any changed compensation config for private data; the export refuses verified mode, but cannot identify arbitrary sensitive values.
